title: Commons Math fraction percentages across integer overflow
summary: Multiplying a numerator by 100 in its integer representation changes the percentage near the signed 32-bit boundary.

change.description: Multiplying a numerator by 100 in its integer representation changes the percentage near the signed 32-bit boundary.
